# Box3D reference dependency

Voxys uses Box3D as a CPU physics reference backend.

- Repository: <https://github.com/erincatto/box3d>
- Pinned commit: `d421e45c828f6f853a145f726f0b9425d31146eb`
- License: MIT

The fetched checkout retains Box3D's original `LICENSE` and source notices.
Updates require an explicit commit change, release-note review, reference-test
run, benchmark comparison, and documented determinism-hash changes.
